name: x4codesense-workspace
description: Language support for X4: Foundations scripts: core library, language server, command line checker and VS Code extension.

scripts.typecheck:tests: tsc -p packages/catalog/tests && tsc -p packages/core/tests && tsc -p packages/server/tests && tsc -p packages/cli/tests && tsc -p packages/mcp/tests && tsc -p client/tests
scripts.clean: rimraf packages/catalog/out packages/core/out packages/server/out packages/cli/out client/out client/dist
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package -w client
